method: WebFetch (re-fetched with query strings to avoid stale caches) of each course page on warwick.ac.uk (start date 27 September 2027), plus Warwick Student Finance pages: UG Overseas Fees (warwick.ac.uk/services/finance/studentfinance/fees/overseasfees/, last updated 21 Aug 2026) and UG Home Fees (.../ugtuitionfees2017onwards/, last updated 21 Sept 2026). Overseas table rows were read through WebFetch summaries (course-by-course 2027-28 column, all Band 2 = £37,310).

universityWideStatements.quote: the tuition fee cap for UK undergraduate students for the 2027-28 academic year would increase to £10,050
universityWideStatements.title: UG Home Fees - Student Finance - University of Warwick
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Home fees 2027-28 (most undergraduate courses listed at £10,050; some foundation-year courses TBA). Not used as a university-wide fee: each course page states £10,050 itself (scope course).

fees.yearEvidence: For the 2027-28 academic year, the UK government announced in March 2026 that the tuition fee cap for UK undergraduate students for the 2027-28 academic year would be £10,050.
fees.note: Course page (start date 27 September 2027) shows "Tuition fee: £10,050" under Home. The page attributes it to the UK government fee cap announced March 2026 but carries no "to be confirmed"/"subject to approval" caveat on the figure.

fees.note: Course page (start date 27 September 2027) shows "Tuition fee: £10,050" under Home. The page attributes it to the UK government fee cap announced March 2026 but carries no "to be confirmed"/"subject to approval" caveat on the figure.
